text:
sam: Starting TileX quant + kernel stitch rollout for tonight's quiet window. Small canary then staged ramp. Need pin, rollback runbook, and RN snippet.
meera: Build ready: tilex-qv2 prebaked, image tag tilex:qv2-stitch. Artifact size +12MB.
qa_tom: Staging smoke: p95 up 3%, one non-deterministic rounding case on seq=12k observed. Captured repro.
ops_jake: Acceptance: error rate <0.2%, p95 regression <8%. If breach for 2 consecutive 1m buckets we pause and revert.
sam: I'll request sticky pin to legacy-engine:v9 for fast fallback. TTL 7200s.
deploybot: Pin request accepted. sticky-pin id=pin-9901 applied -> legacy-engine:v9 ttl=7200s scope=prod.
meera: Note: kernel change toggles `async-kv-cache` flag. We'll set it only on canary nodes.
ops_jake: Flipped flag on canary: `infractl set pool canary-tilex --flag async-kv-cache=true`  done.
deploybot: Starting canary slice=s-tilex-20240316 weight=0.3% bundle=tilex:qv2-stitch change_id=chg-881.
qa_tom: First smoke ok, no OOMs. p95 +2.9%, mismatch 0.12%.
docs_ina: Draft RN line: "TileX qv2 (stitch) 1: experimental quant/abi stitch; canary rollout; fallback=legacy-engine:v9; watch p95 and model mismatch."
sam: Rollback quick command: `deploybot rollback --slice s-tilex-20240316 --to legacy-engine:v9`  ops+eng leads have perms.
deploybot: Increased weight -> 5% change_id=chg-882.
qa_tom: 00:08 saw brief spike in socket resets in us-east-1b. Ops diverted traffic; no errors persisted.
ops_jake: Keeping pin until 02:00. If stable at 01:00 sam will approve unpin.
sam: Thanks all. Will monitor and signoff if green. :rocket:
